Cookies.description: Configures the names of the cookies used by the tenant, in a section per module. Leave a name empty to keep its default name. Can be set in a section named after a tenant, e.g. 'OrchardCore:MyTenant:Cookies'; names set directly under 'OrchardCore' apply to all tenants. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Configuration/#cookie-names.

Themes.description: The names of the cookies used by the 'OrchardCore.Themes' module and the admin themes.

AdminTheme.description: The cookie holding the light or dark mode picked in the admin. Defaults to '{TenantName}-admintheme'.

AdminPreferences.description: The cookie holding the admin preferences, e.g. the state of the admin menu. Defaults to '{TenantName}-adminPreferences'.
